claimed_root_cause: HSTS emission depends on externally observed HTTPS and edge configuration.
description: HSTS is emitted only when enabled and the externally observed scheme is HTTPS; edge duplication behavior is deployment-specific.

evidence.description: HSTS branch requires positive max-age and externally HTTPS scheme.
External scheme trusts forwarded proto only from a configured proxy.
Production example enables one-year HSTS and warns about duplicate edge emission.

title: HSTS emission depends on edge HTTPS observation
